messages.content:
Title: Diagnosis
Details: The test `isUnixSymlinkIsFalseIfMoreThanOneFlagIsSet()` checks that a ZipArchiveEntry with a complex Unix permissions bit pattern does not mistakenly identify the entry as a Unix symlink. The failure indicates that `isUnixSymlink()` returns true erroneously for an entry with Unix permissions value `177777`.

The method `ZipArchiveEntry.isUnixSymlink()` returns true if the Unix mode flags on the entry exactly match the `LINK_FLAG` bit (octal 0120000). Internally, it calls `getUnixMode()`, which extracts a 16-bit unsigned integer from the external attributes of the entry if the platform is Unix, or returns 0 otherwise.

`LINK_FLAG` is a bit pattern representing the Unix symlink file type. The current logic compares `(getUnixMode() & LINK_FLAG) == LINK_FLAG`, which returns true if the symlink bit is set anywhere in the mode value.

The problem is that this bitwise test will also return true if other bits are set alongside the symlink bit, like in mode `177777`. In Unix permission bits, the file type field is represented by several bits, so multiple flags can be set simultaneously, meaning this check becomes insufficient to distinguish pure symlinks.

The failing test with an entry that has permissions `177777` (which has multiple high bits set) demonstrates that `isUnixSymlink()` incorrectly returns true. The expected behavior is that the entry should only be recognized as a symlink if the mode matches the symlink file type exactly, not just contains its bit pattern.

This explains the bug: the use of a simple bitwise AND equality to `LINK_FLAG` allows other bits to be on, leading to false positives for symlinks under certain Unix permission masks.

Recent bug reports are unrelated, so they do not affect the diagnosis.

# Suggested fix location:
The fix should be implemented in `ZipArchiveEntry.isUnixSymlink()`, changing its logic to more precisely identify Unix symlink file types by a strict equality comparison or masking out unrelated permission bits before checking the type bits.
org.apache.commons.compress.archivers.zip.ZipArchiveEntry.isUnixSymlink()

Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).
